facts: The supplied Table1 absorption peak positions are identical for these three members at the printed resolution, while their reported emission peaks are very close. This is an observation to explain, not proof of identical electronic structure.
Cbz measurements are available together with the other two at task start; they are not a blind holdout.
measurement_definitions: Absorption, vertical emission,0–0 energy and excited-state absorption are different physical transitions. State the initial/final electronic states, geometry and solvent response behind each quantity.
A TD calculation relative to an S0 electronic reference at an S1-optimized geometry does not by that geometry label alone compute S1→Sn excited-state absorption.
Reported peak positions are rounded experimental observations and are not exact vertical-excitation targets.
public_data_status: Available at task start; retrospective observations. No blind release mechanism is claimed.
